demos.title: Robotics competitive intelligence
demos.description: One shared brief. Five independent researchers. A comparison you can trace back to its sources.
demos.takeaway: Parallel research works when every researcher uses the same questions and evidence rules.
demos.flow_note: Five researchers, run in two batches. Select a company to read its saved profile.
sources: Research window: October 17, 2025 to October 17, 2026. Older financing benchmarks are dated explicitly.
Profiles link to company announcements, counterparty reports, filings and attributed press reports.
Company-reported operating metrics are unaudited. Proposed SPAC values and reported acquisition talks are not closed financing rounds.

steps.action: Explore the five company profiles.
steps.point: One shared brief makes independent research comparable.
steps.label: Explore the five company profiles.

steps.action: Compare Figure AI and Physical Intelligence.
steps.point: The same five headings keep dates, definitions and sources alongside each claim.
steps.label: Compare [Figure AI](research/figure-ai.md) and [Physical Intelligence](research/physical-intelligence.md).

steps.action: Read the research synthesis.
steps.point: Compare five differentiators and three investment committee implications. Momentum labels are analytical judgments.
steps.label: Read the [research synthesis](research/summary.md).

steps.action: Open the competitor matrix.
steps.point: Inspect dated numeric inputs and evidence-age formulas. Missing capital is not zero.
steps.label: Open the [competitor matrix](research/competitor-matrix.xlsx).

steps.action: Compare the commercial evidence in the company profiles.
steps.point: Capacity, production, orders and paid customer deliveries measure different things.
steps.label: Compare the commercial evidence in the company profiles.

steps.action: Explore the IC slides.
steps.point: Connect the landscape and differentiators to the next diligence questions.
steps.label: Explore the [IC slides](IC-pack.pdf).

demos.prompt:
Research Figure AI, Physical Intelligence, Skild AI, Agility Robotics and 1X Technologies using a separate researcher for each. Batch researchers if the concurrency limit requires it. Use one explicit 12-month window and cutoff date. Use these exact headings: 1 Funding & valuation; 2 Technology; 3 Commercial traction; 4 Manufacturing & scale; 5 Team, partners & risks. Date every factual bullet and end it with a numbered source citation. Prefer filings, companies and counterparties. Label unaudited operating metrics company-reported, unconfirmed transactions reported, and older latest benchmarks with a warning. Do not equate capacity, production, orders and deliveries.

Save five profiles and structured evidence. Verify at least three material facts per company. Synthesize a side-by-side comparison, five differentiators, evidence-based momentum judgments and three IC implications. Build a formula-capable workbook with numeric inputs, visible sources, guarded valuation/capital ratios and useful evidence-age calculations. Produce and visually verify exactly three IC slides. Preserve source material. Do not activate automation, publish or send communications.

demos.title: Pitch review panel
demos.description: Three reviewers challenge the same pitch. Follow the disagreements all the way to a decision.
demos.takeaway: Independent perspectives are useful when disagreements are resolved against shared evidence.
demos.flow_note: Fictional company and data. Select a reviewer to read the actual saved review.
sources: Fictional GraspLoop AI deck: 11 pages. KPI data: September 2025 through September 2026.
Paying revenue, unpaid pilots, best-site performance and fleet averages have distinct definitions.
157.14% NRR covers the original three-customer cohort. The payback calculation uses net new MRR; acquisition-cohort inputs and a funded forward cash plan are unavailable.

steps.action: Read the fictional pitch deck, pages 6–7.
steps.point: Compare its ARR, gross margin and CAC claims with the supplied data. All company data are invented.
steps.label: Read the fictional [pitch deck](../../../Agentic_AI_Demos/demo2_pitchbook_review/inputs/pitch-deck.pdf), pages 6–7.

steps.action: Open the partner briefing.
steps.point: Paying ARR is $1.932M; September gross margin is 41%. The conclusion supports a focused founder meeting.
steps.label: Open the [partner briefing](partner-briefing.pdf).

steps.action: Explore the calculation results.
steps.point: Q3 sales and marketing spend / net new MRR / ending gross margin gives 26.27 months. This is a proxy, not verified acquisition-cohort CAC.
steps.label: Explore the [calculation results](calculation-results.md).

steps.action: Compare the narrative, numbers and devil’s-advocate perspectives above.
steps.point: Separate a repairable story, supported arithmetic and unresolved commercial risks.
steps.label: Compare the narrative, numbers and devil’s-advocate perspectives above.

steps.action: Read the consolidated review and burn sensitivities.
steps.point: A 24-month runway requires a forward hiring, deployment and cash plan. Pre-raise cash/current burn cannot settle that claim.
steps.label: Read the [consolidated review](pitch-review.md) and [burn sensitivities](forward-burn-sensitivity.csv).

steps.action: Explore the founder email example.
steps.point: Turn the findings into specific questions and priorities. The example is an unsent draft.
steps.label: Explore the [founder email example](founder-email.md).

demos.prompt: Review the fictional GraspLoop AI Series A deck against its supplied CSV and data dictionary. Follow `Agentic_AI_Demos/demo2_pitchbook_review/plugin/skills/pitch-review/SKILL.md` and all three agent definitions. Spawn three genuinely independent narrative, numbers and devil's-advocate reviewers. Have them send direct, substantive challenges, revise findings when warranted. Recompute quantitative deck claims using source page and physical CSV row/period references; no reference-output copying. Distinguish paying revenue from pilots, best site from fleet, projections from actuals, and unavailable evidence from falsity. Test the 4-month deck CAC claim and explain exactly when an approximately 26-month proxy is reproducible. Use Q3, trailing-year and monthly intervals, and distinguish net new MRR from gross acquisition cohorts. Test runway with explicit forward-burn assumptions, not merely cash/current burn. Save one file per reviewer, claims JSON, runnable calculation script and results, consolidated review, one-page partner brief, and optional unsent founder email. All company information must be labelled fictional teaching material. Save to a new dated run folder, preserve supplied inputs/reference artifacts,. Do not send, schedule or publish anything.

demos.title: Alphabet valuation model
demos.description: A reusable valuation skill becomes a working model. Change an assumption and inspect what moves.
demos.takeaway: A reusable skill needs explicit inputs, formula checks and a clear boundary around missing evidence.
demos.flow_note: Open the workbook in Excel for live recalculation. Compare DCF, forward P/E and EV/EBITD with their stated assumptions.
sources: Snapshot: October 17, 2026. Market quotes and adjusted EPS consensus are dated October 16; financial inputs run through June 30.
The workbook contains sources, explicit assumptions and live formulas. Open it in Excel for recalculation. This is a teaching model, not investment advice.
WACC is 9.75%; terminal growth is 3.0%. Peer methodologies and economic limitations are explained in the valuation memo and peer methodology.

steps.action: Open the workbook on Summary.
steps.point: Base DCF is $212.65; sensitivity is $158.92–$312.31. The dated market price is $340.59.
steps.label: Open [the workbook](GOOGL_DCF_Valuation.xlsx) on Summary.

steps.action: In Excel, change Assumptions!E84 from 46% to 36%, then restore 46%.
steps.point: 2027 capex sensitivity increases DCF to $217.17 while holding other assumptions fixed.
steps.label: In Excel, change Assumptions!E84 from 46% to 36%, then restore 46%.

steps.action: Use Assumptions!D4: 2 Bull, 3 Bear, then 1 Base.
steps.point: Base is $212.65; Bull $301.67; Bear $119.18. Forecast assumptions change while historical actuals stay fixed.
steps.label: Use Assumptions!D4: 2 Bull, 3 Bear, then 1 Base.

steps.action: Explore Sensitivity!C9:H23.
steps.point: Terminal value is 94.0% of enterprise value. Market price requires 1.66x modeled terminal FCF at Base WACC and growth.
steps.label: Explore Sensitivity!C9:H23.

steps.action: Read peer methodology and Multiples!C72:J82.
steps.point: Forward P/E uses dated CY2027 adjusted EPS. Microsoft uses an equal-half fiscal-year approximation. Peer median implies $364.83.
steps.label: Read [peer methodology](peer-methodology.md) and Multiples!C72:J82.

steps.action: Inspect Multiples!C84:J95 and the valuation memo.
steps.point: EV/EBITD uses EBIT plus PP&E depreciation, keeping intangible amortization expensed. Peer median implies $273.30.
steps.label: Inspect Multiples!C84:J95 and the [valuation memo](valuation-notes.md).

demos.prompt: Create a sourced Alphabet valuation workbook with historical financials, editable assumptions, a five-year forecast, DCF and sensitivity, and comparable peer methods. Cite the date and source of each financial input. Separate assumptions from reported results. Use EV/EBITD (EBIT plus PP&E depreciation) consistently across peers, and explain the calendarization of forward earnings. Show a range and the economic limitations of each method.

demos.title: NVIDIA annual report dashboard
demos.description: An annual report becomes evidence, analysis, a Board brief and an interactive dashboard.
demos.takeaway: Sequential handoffs make each stage inspectable before the next stage starts.
demos.flow_note: Historical FY2026 report. Select a stage to inspect its saved handoff.
sources: NVIDIA FY2026 annual report and Q2, Q3 and Q4 earnings releases. FY2026 ended January 25, 2026; the 10-K was filed February 25.
Financial citations show printed 10-K pages and PDF pages. The annual-report front matter produces an 88-page offset.
Reported segments and end markets are different reporting views. Missing disclosures remain unavailable; calculations show inputs and formulas.

steps.label: Open the [annual report](inputs/10K-NVDA.pdf) and [financial evidence](financials.md).

demos.prompt:
Build an annual-report dashboard using four genuinely sequential agents with isolated contexts.
Use only official, archived sources and save source URLs, retrieval dates and hashes. Record the
fiscal period separately from the run date. Preserve the supplied source and reference outputs.

Stage 1 reads the annual report and the assigned official earnings releases. Extract the
semiconductor KPI checklist to financials.md. Keep period, reported name, segment, units,
printed page, 1-based PDF page, zero-based PDF index, source heading, and comparability notes.
For HTML-only releases cite the exact heading and URL. Missing means not disclosed, never zero.
Include machine-readable rows and validate financial/segment/platform/cash-flow reconciliations.

Gate and save stage 1 before starting stage 2. Stage 2 reads ONLY financials.md and writes
trends.md. Show every calculation with formula and numerical inputs. Separate management's
stated explanation from interpretation. Keep source locators in trends.md so it stands alone.
Do not attribute an unquantified residual margin change to one named driver.

Gate and save stage 2 before stage 3. Stage 3 reads ONLY trends.md and writes a one-page
exec-summary.md: exactly 5 Board headlines, 3 risks and 3 questions, with source references.

Gate and save stage 3 before stage 4. Stage 4 reads ONLY those three intermediate files and
creates dashboard.html with embedded CSS, JavaScript and data; no server, CDN or network
dependency. Include eight annual KPI cards, Board/CFO/Investor card ordering, a reportable-
segment filter, separate dollars/ratios charts, annual and quarterly figures, historical guidance
comparisons where verified, platform revenue, Board insights, searchable/sortable evidence,
calculation formulas/inputs, CSV download and print CSS. Mark group-only metrics and preserve
the distinction between market platforms and reportable segments.

Reconcile embedded data to the intermediate files. Test actual browser interactions, offline
loading, CSV download and print rendering. Do not schedule tasks, send communications or publish externally.
